sentences.en: Between 1908 and 1924, Gwendoline and Margaret Davies amassed one of the largest collections of late-nineteenth and early-twentieth-century French paintings in Britain
sentences.zh: 1908年至1924年间，格温多琳与玛格丽特·戴维斯收藏了一批19世纪晚期至20世纪早期的法国画作，规模位居英国同类收藏前列。

sentences.en: Gwendoline (1882-1951) and Margaret (1884-1963) Davies were the granddaughters of David Davies, a Welshman who amassed a fortune in the shipping and mining industries.
sentences.zh: 格温多琳·戴维斯（1882—1951）和玛格丽特·戴维斯（1884—1963）是戴维·戴维斯的孙女。她们的祖父是威尔士人，凭借航运业和采矿业积累了巨额财富。

sentences.en: In 1907, when Gwendoline came into her inheritance (Margaret would follow in 1909), the sisters were said to be the wealthiest unmarried women in Britain.
sentences.zh: 1907年，格温多琳继承遗产，当时据说这对姐妹是全英国最富有的未婚女性。玛格丽特则要到1909年才继承遗产。

sentences.en: Their religious upbringing in rural Wales gave them a deep sense of social responsibility and they chose to use their inheritance for cultural and philanthropic* purposes.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩在威尔士乡村受到的宗教教养赋予了她们强烈的社会责任感，她们决定把继承的财富用于文化和慈善事业。

sentences.en: While there was no real family history of art collecting, the sisters' education was rigorously geared toward such pursuits.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭虽然并没有什么收藏艺术品的传统，但姐妹俩所受的教育却很有针对性，正是朝这类兴趣活动来培养她们的。

sentences.en: Their London school focused on cultural rather than academic study, and they travelled extensively with their governess, Jane Blaker, visiting art galleries and making extensive notes on the collections there.
sentences.zh: 她们在伦敦就读的学校更看重文化修养，学术研习则居于其次。她们还随家庭女教师简·布莱克四处旅行，参观美术馆，并为馆中藏品作了大量笔记。

sentences.en: The sisters began to make regular art purchases from 1908, which roughly coincided with the dates of their inheritance.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩从1908年开始定期购买艺术品，大致就在两人先后继承遗产的那几年。

sentences.en: They took advice from various people, including the art dealer Hugh Blaker (the brother of Jane Blaker) and David Croal Thompson, who was also an art dealer.
sentences.zh: 她们向多方征求意见，其中包括艺术品经销商休·布莱克（简·布莱克的兄弟），以及同为艺术品经销商的戴维·克罗尔·汤普森。

sentences.en: While it was long assumed that these men were largely responsible for the nature of the sisters' collection, it has recently been accepted that Gwendoline and Margaret retained a far more active role in the process.
sentences.zh: 长期以来，人们以为主要是这两位经销商决定了姐妹俩收藏什么样的作品；近来人们才认可，其实格温多琳和玛格丽特自己在收藏过程中发挥了积极得多的作用。

sentences.en: The sisters' journals reveal their preference for Old Master** paintings.
sentences.zh: 从姐妹俩的日记可以看出，她们偏爱欧洲古典大师的画作。

sentences.en: Yet they initially made very few attempts to secure any such works.
sentences.zh: 然而起初，她们很少尝试把这类作品买下来。

sentences.en: While the sisters were wealthy in relative terms, their income was nothing compared to the fortunes of American art collectors of this period, such as J. Pierpont Morgan.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩尽管相对富裕，但她们的收入同这一时期美国艺术品收藏家的巨额财富相比，根本不值一提，皮尔庞特·摩根就是这样一位美国收藏家。

sentences.en: Quite simply, high quality Old Master works were, if not beyond their means, then beyond what they were willing to pay for them.
sentences.zh: 说得直白些，品质上乘的古典大师画作，即使姐妹俩付得起，价格也超过了她们愿意出的数目。

sentences.en: Instead, their early purchases were of the fashionable, safe variety, and included, for example, paintings by the French artist Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot.
sentences.zh: 她们早期买的反而是时兴、稳妥的那一类作品，其中就有法国画家让-巴蒂斯特-卡米耶·柯罗的画。

sentences.en: However, it was only a few years before their collecting took a new direction and they turned to the work of the French Impressionists***.
sentences.zh: 不过，只过了几年，她们的收藏方向就发生了变化，转向了法国印象派画家的作品。

sentences.en: We know that Hugh Blaker, as a champion of contemporary French art had a hand in the decision, and we know also that they would have seen examples on their various trips to Paris.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，当代法国艺术的拥护者休·布莱克参与促成了这一决定；我们也知道，姐妹俩在数次巴黎之行中想必见过这类作品。

sentences.en: Whatever the precise reason for this change, their first purchases of Impressionist art, made in October 1912, were scenes of Venice by the French artist Claude Monet.
sentences.zh: 无论这次转变的确切原因是什么，她们首次购入的印象派作品都是法国画家克洛德·莫奈描绘威尼斯景色的画作，购于1912年10月。

sentences.en: Over the next 12 years, the sisters amassed the bulk of their Impressionist collection, including six further works by Monet, two more by Manet, and three by Renoir, including his well-known painting La Parisienne.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的12年里，姐妹俩购入了她们印象派藏品中的大部分，其中还有六幅莫奈的画、两幅马奈的画和三幅雷诺阿的画，后者包括名作《巴黎女郎》。

sentences.en: The First World War (1914-1918) played a part in the development of the sisters' collection.
sentences.zh: 第一次世界大战（1914—1918）在姐妹俩收藏的发展过程中也起了作用。

sentences.en: Their initial response to the war effort was to finance the safe passage of artists from occupied Belgium to Wales, as a humanitarian act, but also with the hope of establishing a vibrant artists' community in the area.
sentences.zh: 战争初起，姐妹俩出资让艺术家从被占领的比利时安全前往威尔士；这既是出于人道考虑，她们也希望在当地建立一个充满活力的艺术家群体。

sentences.en: Later in the conflict, both sisters decided to volunteer at a canteen for troops at Troyes, in northern France; Gwendoline in 1916, followed by Margaret in 1917.
sentences.zh: 战事持续期间，姐妹俩后来都决定去法国北部特鲁瓦的一家军人食堂当志愿者。格温多琳于1916年前往，玛格丽特则于1917年跟随她的脚步。

sentences.en: It was tedious and distressing work, which would have a permanent effect on Gwendoline's health.
sentences.zh: 这份工作单调乏味，也让人痛心，给格温多琳的健康留下了永久影响。

sentences.en: Yet on one of numerous trips to nearby Paris, she visited the Bernheim-Jeune Gallery.
sentences.zh: 不过，在多次前往附近巴黎的旅程中，有一次她去了贝尔内姆-热纳画廊。

sentences.en: Here she acquired two works by Cézanne – Provençal Landscape and The François Zola Dam.
sentences.zh: 她在这里买下了两幅塞尚的作品——《普罗旺斯风景》和《弗朗索瓦·左拉水坝》。

sentences.en: The paintings were shipped directly to Bath, England, where they became the first works by Cézanne to go on display in a public gallery in Britain.
sentences.zh: 这两幅画被直接运到英格兰的巴斯，成为英国第一批在公共美术馆展出的塞尚作品。

sentences.en: Commentators have often described the sisters as unlikely pioneer collectors.
sentences.zh: 评论者常说，很难想到这对姐妹会成为开先河的收藏家。

sentences.en: Much is made of their isolation in rural Wales and the fact that they didn't make friends with artists or gallery owners.
sentences.zh: 人们常拿两件事大做文章：她们远居威尔士乡间，而且同艺术家或画廊老板没有私交。

sentences.en: Yet they didn't feel obliged to follow fashionable tastes and were free to pursue their own preferences.
sentences.zh: 然而，她们并不觉得自己有义务追随流行品味，尽可以按自己的喜好收藏。

sentences.en: Although they relied on a trusted circle of advisers, they made frequent trips to London and Paris, and also regularly had paintings sent to their home for consideration.
sentences.zh: 虽然她们倚重一群信任的顾问，却也经常亲自去伦敦和巴黎，还常让人把画送到家里，供自己挑选斟酌。

sentences.en: By the early 1920s, Gwendoline felt increasingly uncomfortable buying art works when faced with the poverty and social upheaval created by the First World War.
sentences.zh: 到了20世纪20年代初，面对一战造成的贫困和社会动荡，格温多琳在购买艺术品时越发感到不安。

sentences.en: Her philanthropic pursuits then became focused almost exclusively on social causes and the development of the sisters' home at Gregynog Hall into a conference center and venue for the Gregynog Festival of Music and Poetry.
sentences.zh: 此后，她几乎将全部慈善精力用于社会公益事业，以及改建姐妹俩的住所格雷吉诺格庄园，把这里建成会议中心和格雷吉诺格音乐与诗歌节的举办场地。

sentences.en: Gwendoline made her final art purchase in March 1926.
sentences.zh: 格温多琳最后一次购藏艺术品是在1926年3月。

sentences.en: Margaret also stopped collecting around this time, but started again in the 1930s acquiring, on a relatively small scale, work by contemporary British artists.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特也在这段时期暂停收藏，但在20世纪30年代又开始购买当代英国艺术家的作品，只是规模相对较小。

sentences.en: The sisters collected French Impressionist paintings at a time when such art was routinely ignored by individuals and institutions alike.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩收藏法国印象派绘画时，无论个人还是机构，通常都对这类艺术漠不关心。

sentences.en: The Gwendoline and Margaret Davies collection, donated in 1951 and 1963 respectively to the National Museum Wales, contains major examples of work by leading French Impressionists.
sentences.zh: 格温多琳和玛格丽特·戴维斯的收藏分别于1951年和1963年捐给威尔士国家博物馆，其中有多位法国印象派名家的重要代表作。

sentences.en: In collecting paintings that they loved, the sisters created a lasting and meaningful cultural legacy for the people of Wales and beyond.
sentences.zh: 姐妹俩收藏自己喜爱的画作，为威尔士乃至更广地区的人们留下了一份意义深远、经久不衰的文化遗产。

questions.question: their grandfather's wealth came from ______ and transportation businesses
questions.logic: 先锁定祖父 David Davies 的财富来源。原文并列 shipping 和 mining 两个行业。题干已用 transportation businesses 改写了 shipping，空格要填另一项 mining。

questions.question: their ______ was designed to give them an interest in activities such as collecting art
questions.logic: 题干问哪一种经历旨在培养姐妹俩收藏艺术品的兴趣。原文说她们的 education 是针对这类活动安排的。下一句的学校和参观画廊都是这种教育的具体方式，不能用某一次活动代替总称。

questions.question: they took lengthy ______ about the things they saw in art galleries
questions.logic: 跟着 governess 和 art galleries 找到参观画廊的经历。原文的 making extensive notes 对应题干 took lengthy …；动作换了说法，记录下来的东西仍是 notes，要保留复数。

questions.question: their ______ showed they liked Old Master paintings, but they were expensive to buy
questions.logic: 空格前的 their 和后面的 showed 表明，需要找一种能反映姐妹俩喜好的记录。原文的 The sisters’ journals reveal their preference 中，reveal 对应 showed，preference 对应 liked。应填 journals，即她们自己的日记。

questions.question: the first Impressionist paintings they bought showed places in ______
questions.logic: 看 showed places in 问的是画里描绘的地点。姐妹俩买的是莫奈所画的 scenes of Venice，因此写 Venice。法国是画家的国籍，1912年10月是购买时间。

questions.question: they worked in a ______ for soldiers in France
questions.logic: 题干的 worked for soldiers 指她们在法国的志愿服务。原文地点是 a canteen for troops，troops 对应 soldiers。Troyes 是食堂所在的城市，空格要填设施名称 canteen。

questions.question: were not considered typical collectors - they lived in isolation in the countryside and did not have any ______ who were artists
questions.logic: 题干的 who were artists 修饰空格中的人。原文用 didn’t make friends with artists or gallery owners，说的是姐妹俩没有结交这两类人。用复数与 any … who were 搭配。

questions.question: The Davies sisters' childhood influenced the way they decided to use their wealth.
questions.logic: 把 childhood 对回 religious upbringing。童年所受教养带来了社会责任感，随后她们决定把继承的财富用于文化和慈善。这条因果链支持题干所说的影响。

questions.question: The Jean-Baptiste-Camille Corot paintings in the Davies sisters' collection were purchased from a gallery in France.
questions.logic: 文中说姐妹俩买过法国画家柯罗的画。French 交代的是画家的国籍，作品来自法国哪一家画廊并未交代。后文的巴黎旅行也不能补出这笔交易的地点。

questions.question: Hugh Blaker opposed the Davies sisters' decision to buy art by French Impressionists.
questions.logic: 找到休·布莱克在决定中的角色。a champion 表示他支持当代法国艺术，had a hand in the decision 说明他参与促成了购买。题干的 opposed 把他的立场反了过来。

questions.question: The exhibition of Cézanne paintings at the Bath gallery was very popular with the public.
questions.logic: 巴斯的画廊展出了两幅塞尚作品，原文强调这是英国公共美术馆首次展出其作品。首次展出只说明先后次序，没有说明观众人数或公众是否喜欢。

questions.question: The impact of the First World War encouraged Gwendoline to reconsider her interest in collecting art.
questions.logic: 找一战之后格温多琳态度的变化。面对贫困和社会动荡，她对继续购画越来越不安。这支持 reconsider；题干没有说她当时立即停止了收藏。

questions.question: The Davies sisters bought French Impressionist art during a period when very few people were doing so.
questions.logic: 题干问当时的收藏风气。原文说个人和机构普遍对印象派绘画兴趣不大。姐妹俩正是在这样的时期收藏这些作品。

grammar.heading: 对照两种认知
grammar.analysis: 主句是 it has recently been accepted that …。句首 While 引入长期以来的旧看法，主句给出近来得到认可的新看法。两个 it 都是形式主语，各自的 that 从句才是人们以为或认可的内容。
grammar.pattern: While it was once assumed that …, evidence now suggests that …
grammar.task: Task 2 · 讨论线上教育能否惠及偏远地区
grammar.example: While it was once assumed that online lessons would reach every village, evidence from enrolment records may reveal gaps in internet access.
grammar.example_zh: 人们一度以为网课能覆盖每个村庄，但注册记录可能反映出上网条件的差距。
grammar.usage: 前后必须是针对同一认识的新旧判断。没有证据时保留 may，避免把推测写成已有定论。

grammar.heading: 插入语修饰哪个名词
grammar.analysis: 去掉两个逗号之间的 made in October 1912，主干是 their first purchases … were scenes of Venice。made 是过去分词，补充作品购入的时间。句首 Whatever the precise reason … 表示不论真正原因是什么。
grammar.pattern: Whatever the reason for …, [主语], [过去分词短语], [谓语] …
grammar.task: Task 1 · 两幅地图比较市中心设施的变化
grammar.example: Whatever the reason for the redesign, the new cycle lanes, installed along the main road, connect the station to the park.
grammar.example_zh: 无论改造的原因是什么，沿主路铺设的新自行车道连接了车站和公园。
grammar.usage: 地图能支持车道的位置和连接关系。若题目没有提供改造原因，只报告能看见的变化。

grammar.heading: 同一主语带出两个动作
grammar.analysis: Although 从句承认姐妹俩依赖顾问。主句共用主语 they，先说 made frequent trips，再说 had paintings sent。have + 宾语 + 过去分词强调安排别人把画送来，不能译成她们亲自送画。
grammar.pattern: Although …, [主语] … and also had [宾语] [过去分词].
grammar.task: Task 2 · 讨论公共设施无障碍改造
grammar.example: Although the council consulted engineers, it also visited stations and had several entrances inspected by wheelchair users.
grammar.example_zh: 尽管市议会咨询了工程师，它还是走访了车站，并请轮椅使用者检查了几个入口。
grammar.usage: had the entrances inspected 的宾语是 entrances，实际检查者是 wheelchair users。
